hero.intro: Start free and see what ReelBolt makes of your footage.
hero.firstVideo: Your first video is on us: {credits} credits when you verify your email. Trial exports are 720p with a watermark.

page.notSure: Not sure which one fits? Tell us what you are making and we will say which plan you actually need. <link>Get in touch.</link>

compare.title: Compare the plans
compare.intro: The same limits the platform enforces, side by side. Every plan can produce the same kinds of video; what changes is resolution, the extras, priority and how many credits come with it.

cta.body: No card required. Make your first video and decide afterwards which plan it needs.

page.taxNote: Prices exclude VAT and sales tax, which are added at checkout.
